# kcore_security_group (Resource)

Security group (`kctl security-group`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_security_group" "web" {
  name        = "web"
  description = "public web"

  rule {
    protocol    = "tcp"
    host_port   = 443
    target_port = 443
    source_cidr = "0.0.0.0/0"
  }
}
```
